Starting Balances — Inventory Items

The Starting Balances screen allows you to set up your starting balances for the inventory items you have created under the Inventory Items tab. This is essential when you are beginning to use inventory tracking or transitioning from another accounting system.

To create a new starting balance for an inventory item, click the New Starting Balance button.

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the inventory item. For more information on how to complete this form, see Starting Balance for Inventory Item Form.
